hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom-curve hook that uses Euler Finance vaults as liquidity sources. In beforeSwap, it deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another vault, and enforces a custom curve invariant (EulerSwap v1), returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap's standard AMM pricing entirely. Standard add-liquidity, donations, and direct pool initialization are all reverted.
